acceptedResidualRisks: The current GitHub plan does not provide server-side pre-receive protection for this private repository.
A contents-write actor can technically create a main commit before post-push detection reacts.
A direct writer could attempt to modify repository-hosted detection workflows in the same commit.
mandatoryCompensatingControls: Normal writes must explicitly target a non-default branch.
All normal changes must enter main through pull requests.
Main Provenance audits external push and token-driven autonomous merge paths.
An unverified main update creates an R3 incident and halts ordinary autonomous merges.
Automatic recovery is proposed only as a Draft pull request from a trusted push event.
R2 and R3 changes require a current-HEAD cold-read AI review.
revisitTriggers: Real user memory, production credentials, or production data are introduced.
More than one human collaborator receives write access.
A production release workflow is introduced.
A second unauthorized direct-main incident occurs.
